text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm spending the last night of summer
camp in the
common room, when...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Open desk, open desk...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heya-hey, Trainer! Yeah, I mean, I'm
just
doing as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The more you get done, the more these
jobs pay
out!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Nah, don't worry about it. Don't
you have
your own work to do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: じゃあ俺も手伝おうかな
じゃあ私も手伝おうかな

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. That look in your eye tells me
you're going
to be extra stubborn today.
choice_data_list: ちょうど暇だったから

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right. I wanted to ask you about my
races
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This'll give you something to keep your
hands
busy with while we discuss stuff.
Sound good?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking the seat next to her, I start
carefully
applying labels to envelopes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is much more skilled with her
hands. As
she neatly places sticker after
sticker, the
mountain of finished
envelopes on the table
grows bigger and
bigger.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So, Trainer. My new running style still
needs a
lot of work, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can tell from the way it feels after a
run. At this
rate, when the race rolls
around, I'll just end up
exhausting all my
energy again.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Even though I know I have to hold
myself back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm reminded of a comment made about
Ines
Fujin's running style during her
junior year—"Her
legs can't keep up with
her heart."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she's been running all
this time on
pure feeling. But that does
mean her passion for
running has always
been extraordinarily high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe suppressing those emotions is a
tougher
task for her than I'd imagined.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. In your eyes, how am I looking?
What do
I need to do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...
choice_data_list: もしも抑えることが難しいなら……

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's my phone. Be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh! Flutter, flutter...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, the envelopes! Ahh, sorry! I'll
sort them
out after this call!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The neatly arranged stack of envelopes
topples
as she darts by, scattering across
the table.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hello, is that you, Cassie? Is Polly with
you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
About that talk we had before—I'm not
budging.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want you both to chase your dreams
too. And
I'm going to do everything I
can to make sure you
can do that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not—that's not what I mean!
Don't
worry, I'm going to keep running!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I know how tough it was for all of you to
support
me, and I'm not going to let that
support go to
waste.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I won't let you two quit. If you need
extra
help, I'll make enough money to
hire someone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make it work—no matter
what Mom
and Dad say!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And if you're still worried, just wait until
the
Kikuka Sho! It won't be a repeat of
the Derby, I
promise.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Click...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew...
